popup_prompt_body.message:
Register our chrome MCP (auto-chrome-mcp) in the .mcp.json of the current working dir (this project folder). Do not touch global config such as ~/.claude.json.

Rules:
- name: "chrome-mcp-stdio"
- transport: stdio (no HTTP)
- command: "node"
- args: ["<output of npm root -g>/auto-chrome-mcp-bridge/dist/mcp/mcp-server-stdio.js"]
- env: { "CHROME_PORT": "$PORT$" }

First run `npm root -g` in bash to get the real path, then add or update only mcpServers.chrome-mcp-stdio in the working dir .mcp.json (create it if missing). Keep every other server entry.

When it is registered, also explain these steps:
1. Quit Claude Code with Ctrl+C twice and start it again (reloads mcp servers)
2. Type `/mcp` and check that chrome-mcp-stdio is connected
3. Press Esc to leave
